proposals.title: Net-Zero Greenhouse Gas Emissions by 2030
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report assessing feasibility and policy options for net-zero greenhouse gas emissions for facilities and major suppliers by 2030.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal No. 5.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to adopt an accelerated recruitment policy to increase diversity of senior management and the board of directors.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal No. 6.

proposals.title: Human Rights Review – High-Risk Regions
proposals.proponent: National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a board review of guidelines for selecting countries and regions for operations and a report identifying criteria for investing in, operating in, and withdrawing from high-risk regions.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal No. 7.

proposals.title: Proposal 8 – Shareholder Proxy Access
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to adopt a proxy access bylaw allowing shareholder-nominated director candidates in company proxy materials under specified ownership and disclosure criteria.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal No. 8.
